figures.caption: Fig. 1: The evaluation pipeline consists of four steps: i) translation, ii) pruning, iii) materialization, and iv) querying. While solid-lined arrows indicate the execution flow including our pruning approach, dashed arrows capture the execution flow without pruning.

Table 1: For each query, the execution time for different steps of the evaluation pipeline is averaged over four runs. The last column reports the querying time when querying the full RDF graph. TO means the execution timed out (3600s).
